about: M4 trigger suite (v1-design-doc.md §10.4, PRD R2.3). 100 prompts: 60 the readable-code skill should activate on, 40 it must not. Negatives are split per §10.4: 10 prose-readability (the dangerous half that shares the skill's vocabulary), 5 code-explanation (reading is not writing), 25 other. Prompts are ground truth for what the skill covers, not a fit to the current description — run_triggers.py measures the gap so #9 can tune the description. All prompts are original prose (AGENTS.md, 'Legal and copyright considerations').
